plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Rovela draws your route and notices the places you visit, even when the app is closed, so your trip can tell its own story. Your location stays on this device.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Rovela uses your location to place notes, photos, and moments on your trip map. Your location stays on this device.

plugins.photosPermission: Rovela finds the photos and videos you took during a trip and places them on your map and timeline. They never leave this device unless you share them.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Rovela saves share cards and trip images to your photo library.

plugins.calendarPermission: Rovela looks for flights, stays, and reservations during your trip dates to fill in your timeline.

plugins.microphonePermission: Rovela records voice memos so you can capture a moment without typing.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Rovela reads your workouts, steps, distance, and elevation during a trip to show how far you went and how high you climbed.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Rovela does not write to Health. This permission is required by iOS but is not used.
